titolo: Google adds Wallet and Drive to Personal Intelligence in Search
descr: Search can now use Google Wallet and Drive data for personalized answers when users opt in.
paragrafi: Google announced that Personal Intelligence in Search will let users connect Google Wallet and Google Drive.
The rollout begins today with Wallet, while Drive and the Gemini app will follow in the coming weeks.
When opted in, Search can reference spending habits, credit‑card rewards, and documents to tailor responses.
Connections are managed in Search Personalization settings and can be turned off at any time.
AI Mode can read Wallet data but cannot move, manage, or invest money.
The Gemini app will soon share context with Search, allowing ideas explored there to inform future queries.
perche: Users gain more relevant answers without manually providing data, streamlining tasks like budgeting or project planning. Free model enthusiasts can compare this deep integration with open‑source options that run locally, noting the trade‑off between convenience and data control.
